text: {"lessons":["My account fell about 11% from Period 2 to Period 10, so I should review whether my decisions are serving my long-run goal rather than assume frequent trading adds value.","Repeatedly switching holdings and selling at losses did not protect the account; set clear, thesis-based reasons for buying and selling, and avoid reacting to cost basis or short-term moves alone.","Before each trade, check cash, concentration, and downside risk, and compare the case for holding with the case for buying or selling; patience is a valid decision."]}
